artworks.title: Martino
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.2 × 8.2 cm (5 3/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene. It depicts a group of armed soldiers surrounding and appearing to attack a fallen figure on the ground. The fallen figure is positioned prominently in the foreground, with an expression of anguish, arms raised defensively. The soldiers are holding swords and spears, wearing helmets and battle armor. Their stance and movement suggest intense action and a struggle. The drawing is in black and white, highlighting intricate line work typical of early engraving or etching techniques. Italicized writing is present at the bottom. The composition portrays chaos and conflict, capturing a dramatic moment.

artworks.title: Bernardino
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13.3 × 8 cm (5 1/4 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battlefield scene. There are several figures in armor engaging in battle, with spears and armor prominently depicted. The drawing captures the intensity of battle with figures on the ground, injured or tending to the wounded. In the background, a formation of soldiers holding spears is visible. The figures are illustrated in a classical style with detailed cross-hatching and shading, emphasizing their forms and the tension of the moment. The scene conveys the chaos and complexity of a battlefield, with a focus on struggle and motion. Below the scene, there is text in Italian.

artworks.title: The Oppressed Woman
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 8.5 cm (5 1/8 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene showing four figures around a bed attending to a prostrate figure. Above them, another figure appears mid-air. To the left, two more figures stand watching or gesturing. The bed is surrounded by draping material, and the drawing is richly detailed with hatching and line work.

artworks.title: Four Women
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.5 × 8.5 cm (5 5/16 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with several figures interacting. The figures are situated in what appears to be a significant or reverent context. The drawing depicts an architectural space with figures dressed in robes and head coverings. They are positioned near an altar or shrine, with one figure seated and others kneeling or standing. The setting includes rows of columns and steps, along with intricate masonry work, implying a chapel or sacred space. The text beneath suggests a liberation theme. The details of their garments and the setting are depicted with fine lines, showing attention to texture and shadowing. The scene conveys a sense of historical and spiritual narrative, focusing on themes of liberation or divine intervention.

artworks.title: Grand Duchess at the Procession of the Young Girls
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.5 × 30 cm (8 7/8 × 11 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures outside a grand architectural building. The scene features finely dressed individuals, attendants, and guards. The setting appears ceremonial with classical columns and detailed exterior walls. The figures wear intricate clothing typical of the medieval or renaissance period.

artworks.title: Restoration of the Duomo, Florence
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.3 × 22.8 cm (8 3/4 × 9 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a group of figures around a table in an architectural setting. The scene includes an interior with arched openings and columns leading to an outdoor view of a classical building featuring domes and spires. At the center of the composition, several figures in period costumes are gathered around a table with a large map or document. To the right, two individuals carry a large framed painting. In the background, guards with halberds stand at attention. The line work and etching techniques add depth and detail to the characters and surroundings.

artworks.title: Construction and Fortification of the Port of Livorno
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.3 × 29.8 cm (8 3/4 × 11 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures engaged in the construction of a large structure. It features a prominent figure seated on a chair under an umbrella, overseeing the activities. To the left, there are laborers engaged in construction work, with some carrying large bricks and others working on scaffolding. The background shows towers and a scene of building activity. The drawing captures a historic or classical architectural setting filled with meticulous details, indicating a significant construction or event.

artworks.title: Construction and Fortification of the Port of Livorno
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene showing architectural planning and construction. The image includes a noble figure sitting on a throne-like chair under a parasol, surrounded by other figures presenting plans or documents. In the background, workers are engaged in construction, with scaffolding and a partially-built stone structure visible. The scene suggests the planning and building of fortifications, with various people participating. The background also shows a detailed landscape with a fortress and more laborers working.

artworks.title: Restoration of the Aqueduct at Pisa
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.2 × 29.9 cm (7 15/16 × 11 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of aristocrats engaged in conversation in front of a cityscape with a construction scene in the background. The image shows a collection of figures in conversation. One central figure is holding a document or map. The accompanying individuals carry weapons and some appear to listen attentively. In the background, there is a walled city with detailed architecture, including domes and spires. A group of workers is engaged in digging or building activity, and a bridge or aqueduct is being constructed with workers laboring at different levels.

artworks.title: Restoration of the Aqueduct at Pisa
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in a scene involving a construction project near a historical cityscape. In the foreground, the image features a central figure pointing, surrounded by others who appear to be engaged in a discussion. They are dressed in historical European clothing. In the background, there is a city with distinctive architecture, including domed buildings. Several people are visible working on the construction of an aqueduct or canal, with animals assisting in the labor. The composition details an organized scene of supervision and labor in a landscape setting.

artworks.title: The Hiring of the Troops
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22 × 29.4 cm (8 11/16 × 11 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a table with a dog nearby. The scene features soldiers holding pikes and wearing historical armor and clothing. There are objects resembling coins on the table. Soldiers in formation are marching to the left, giving a sense of depth. The figures are detailed with textured clothing, suggesting a historical setting. The composition is balanced, focusing on the table scene and military context, depicting a historical narrative of 17th-century life.

artworks.title: The Troops on the March
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.5 × 29.6 cm (8 7/8 × 11 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval battle scene. The artwork features a group of armed individuals, some mounted on horses, gathered in preparation or in the midst of organizing their positions as they face an approaching army in the background. The scene is bustling with activity, each figure engaged in military preparation, holding an array of weapons including spears and shields. The detailed rendering displays the texture of the clothing, the muscular structure of the horses, and the gear they carry, evoking a dynamic sense of movement. The marching army in the background, along with the perspective of the landscape, adds depth and context to the scene.

artworks.title: The Re-embarkation of the Troops
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.3 × 29.6 cm (8 3/4 × 11 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with soldiers engaged in combat. The composition shows warriors fighting with weapons. Fallen soldiers are depicted on the ground. Flags are raised and ships are visible in the background, indicating a maritime aspect to the conflict. The drawing features detailed line work and shading, capturing the dynamism of historical battles.

artworks.title: The Re-embarkation of the Troops
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic battle scene. It shows a large group of armored soldiers engaged in battle, with some pushing a cannon or artillery piece on wheels. The scene is full of movement and intensity, with soldiers in various postures of action and struggle. The foreground is littered with fallen figures, and the background reveals more soldiers, some holding flags or banners. The drawing features intricate detailing of the soldiers' armor, clothing, and weapons, as well as the motion captured in their postures, suggesting a historical and dramatic depiction of warfare.

artworks.title: The Troops Forcing the Gate of a Town
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.2 × 29.6 cm (8 3/4 × 11 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The artwork shows warriors clad in armor engaged in combat, wielding swords and bows. A gate and a wall are depicted on the left side. Archers are shooting arrows, and soldiers are in close combat. More warriors are advancing in formation in the background, with ships visible in the distance. The use of lines and shading creates a dynamic and detailed appearance, capturing the chaos and movement of a battle.

artworks.title: The Second Naval Battle
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19 × 29.5 cm (7 1/2 × 11 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: There is a detailed monochromatic image depicting a naval battle at sea. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing tall ships with masts, sails, and intricate rigging in action. Smoke billows from some ships. The horizon is low in the composition, where the sea meets the sky. The style features detailed lines emphasizing the ships' movement. In the background, dynamic cloud patterns fill the sky.

artworks.title: Assault on the Outer Forts of Bone
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20 × 29.5 cm (7 7/8 × 11 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The scene depicts figures engaged in combat using weapons such as swords, spears, and shields. One group is wearing helmets and armor, while the other group is clad in draped robes and some wear turbans. In the background, there is a fortified structure with smoke rising. The illustration captures the intensity and movement of the clash.

artworks.title: Taking of Bone
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.3 × 29.6 cm (8 3/4 × 11 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient military siege. The scene features a group of armored warriors on a hill preparing to attack a fortified city. Some soldiers are scaling ladders against the walls, and a battle is happening on various fronts, including an approach from the sea with ships in the background. The intricate detailing of the scene showcases skill in rendering human figures and architectural elements, highlighting the intensity and action of the military event. The drawing has a dramatic composition, capturing the tension and movement of the siege.

artworks.title: Assault on Two Fortresses
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.2 × 29.4 cm (8 3/4 × 11 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a historical battle scene featuring soldiers in siege warfare. They are seen advancing towards fortified walls with ladders, firing muskets. In the foreground, a figure in armor is directing the troops towards the battle. The soldiers wear armor, helmets with plumes, and carry weapons like muskets and pikes. Ships are visible in the background, suggesting naval forces may be involved. The drawing captures the chaos and coordination of the military operation with detailed line work, typical of engravings depicting historical events.

artworks.title: Crowning of the Grand Duchess
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.3 × 30.7 cm (9 3/16 × 12 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a regal ceremony in which a figure is being crowned. The drawing depicts an elaborate scene with numerous figures gathered under a decorative canopy. Horses are present on either side of the composition, ridden by figures in heavy clothing and bearing weapons. The central figure is depicted bowing slightly to receive a crown from a figure standing beside them. The background is filled with additional figures dressed in gowns and robes within a richly detailed architectural setting. The scene captures a moment of significance with a focus on the intricate costumes, expressions, and gestures of those present.

artworks.title: Saint Paul, Seated
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 26 × 16.1 cm (10 1/4 × 6 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts an older man seated on a cloth-draped surface. He has a full beard and long, unkempt hair. He is dressed in a long robe and is barefoot, with one arm resting on an object and the other extended outward. Books are stacked around him, and he holds a pen-like object in one hand while a sword lies beside him. In the background, there are rolling clouds, with figures emerging from the clouds near the bottom of the scene. The area is detailed with etched lines, providing texture to the clouds and landscape.

artworks.title: The Assumption with the Cherubin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5 × 4.3 cm (1 15/16 × 1 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene with a gathering below. The image depicts an ethereal figure surrounded by clouds and smaller figures in the upper part, hovering over a group assembled around a central table below. The celestial figure stands in a majestic pose amidst billowing clouds, and smaller figures are engaged in activities above. Below, a group of figures is gathered around a rectangular table, their attire flowing and classical. The composition is enclosed in an oval frame with shading lines providing depth and texture. The style reflects intricate line work typical of classical or baroque graphic art.

artworks.title: The Small Carrying of the Cross
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.6 × 6.7 cm (1 13/16 × 2 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with figures involved in a conflict, some on horses and others on foot, with spears and shields. The composition is crowded and intricate, with numerous figures engaged in struggle. The background shows a cityscape, suggesting an urban setting. A small dog is depicted in the foreground. The overall composition is circular, enhancing the sense of action and movement.

artworks.title: Piazza Publicca, Siena
artworks.artist: Italian 17th Century (Formerly attributed to Jacques Callot)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.6 × 9.9 cm (3 × 3 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a busy square from an elevated point of view. In the center, there is a tall tower, flanked by a building with arches and ornate windows. The detailed drawing uses intricate linework and a monochromatic color palette. People are depicted walking and interacting in the foreground, while buildings shape the urban setting in the distance.
